source_clauses.verbatim: I need a compact folding stand for my desk.
It should have three legs that fold in close to the body, so the whole thing becomes narrow and compact when I put it away.
Everything should stay attached while it is folded.
I do not want to take anything off to fold it, or loose pieces to look after.
When I want to use it, I should be able to open it by hand, following a sequence that makes sense as I go.
The three legs should end up spread apart in different directions so they give the stand a usable footprint on the desk.
Nothing should come apart or fall off while I am opening it, and I should not need tools, a motor, or any other equipment to do it.
Once it is open, it needs to stay open on its own.
I should not have to hold the legs while I use it, and they should not be able to fold back, twist aside, or come off.
Nothing should turn on its own, shift out of place, or move in some other direction I was not expecting.
Before it can be folded again I want to have to do something deliberate, so it does not collapse just because I knocked it.
After that deliberate release, it should fold back down to the same compact shape it started in.
The opening and folding sequence should be repeatable, with all normal parts remaining attached and without anything needing to be removed and put back on.
It is meant to hold a small object on my desk while I am working.
It should also be something that can genuinely be built as a product and put together in a sensible order, and stay together through normal opening and folding.

requirements.observable_verbatim: The stand exists and can be placed on a desk.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should have three legs that fold in close to the body, so the whole thing becomes narrow and compact when I put it away.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The three legs fold in close to the body and the folded stand is narrow and compact.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Everything should stay attached while it is folded.
requirements.observable_verbatim: No part becomes detached during folding.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I do not want to take anything off to fold it, or loose pieces to look after.
requirements.observable_verbatim: Folding is accomplished without removing any part, and there are no loose pieces.

requirements.statement_verbatim: When I want to use it, I should be able to open it by hand, following a sequence that makes sense as I go.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The user can open the stand by hand with an intuitive sequence.

requirements.observable_verbatim: The three legs are spread apart in different directions, providing a stable footprint on the desk.

requirements.observable_verbatim: During opening, no part detaches; no tools or motor are used.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Once it is open, it needs to stay open on its own.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The open stand remains open without external support.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I should not have to hold the legs while I use it, and they should not be able to fold back, twist aside, or come off.
requirements.observable_verbatim: Legs do not move from the open position or detach during use.

requirements.observable_verbatim: No unexpected movement occurs while the stand is in use.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Before it can be folded again I want to have to do something deliberate, so it does not collapse just because I knocked it.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The stand remains open until a deliberate action is performed to fold it.

requirements.statement_verbatim: After that deliberate release, it should fold back down to the same compact shape it started in.
requirements.observable_verbatim: After the deliberate release, the stand folds to the same compact configuration as initially folded.

requirements.statement_verbatim: The opening and folding sequence should be repeatable, with all normal parts remaining attached and without anything needing to be removed and put back on.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The opening and folding sequence can be repeated many times without removal of parts.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It is meant to hold a small object on my desk while I am working.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The stand can hold a small object on a desk during work.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should also be something that can genuinely be built as a product and put together in a sensible order, and stay together through normal opening and folding.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The stand can be manufactured and assembled in a sensible order; it remains intact during normal opening and folding.

ambiguities.statement: The statement 'nothing should turn on its own' is ambiguous with respect to what 'turn' means (rotation about the vertical axis) versus 'shift out of place' (translation), and whether it applies only during use or also during opening/folding.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: During design review with the requester to clarify the exact motions that are prohibited.

assumptions.statement: The desk is a horizontal, stable surface.
assumptions.why: The stand is meant to be used on a desk, and the footprint refers to a stable base.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the desk is not stable or not horizontal.

assumptions.statement: The user has two hands and normal manual dexterity.
assumptions.why: Opening and folding is to be done by hand without tools.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user has limited hand function requiring assistive devices.
